blocks.text: An automation rule automatically triggers one or more playbooks when specific conditions are met on a selected entity, such as an alert, an incident, a user, or an identity finding.
Automation rules provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Automate response, remediation, and orchestration workflows based on defined rules and conditions.
Apply consistent rules and conditions for automatically triggering playbooks.
Combine multiple playbooks to create multi-step automated responses.

blocks.text: On the Automation Rules page (Agentic SOC or Identities > Automations > Automation Rules), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter automation rules by entity, status, or trigger.
Show or hide the playbooks associated with automation rules.
View all automation rules, including their related playbooks when displayed. For each automation rule, you can view:
Name: The name of the automation rule.
Description: The description of the automation rule.
Last Modified: The date when the automation rule was last modified.
Active or Inactive: The status of the automation rule.
Unlink a playbook from an automation rule.
